# Hamza Jhad

> Full-stack software engineer, ERP architect, and co-founder of BirtuCan Technologies PLC based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Specializing in mission-critical operations software, multi-tenant hospitality systems, offline-resilient POS networks, and social welfare platforms.

## Flagship Projects & Live Deployments
- [Restaurant & Hospitality ERP](https://hamzajhad.com/work): All-in-one operations platform managing QR ordering, kitchen dispatch, dual-level inventory, HR attendance, and multi-bank settlement.
  - [Cloud Sun Cafe Bahir Dar](https://cloudsunbahirdar.com/): Table-side QR ordering and automated staff payroll.
  - [Arabian Palace Restaurant](https://arabianpalace-eth.com/): Multi-floor dining and lounge with multi-station kitchen routing.
  - [Cloud Sun Cafe Addis Ababa](https://cloudsun-cafe.com/): High-turnover metropolitan cafe operations and procurement.
  - [KOS Home Cafe](https://koshomecafe.com/): Specialty brunch hub with recipe cost tracking and live inventory.
- [Nur Selam Baltna Manufacturing ERP](https://nurselambaltina.com/): Industrial manufacturing ERP coordinating raw material intake, recipe formulation batching, and distributor logistics.
- [Retail POS & Shop Platform](https://hamzajhad.com/work): Omnichannel retail management with barcode scanning, lot/expiry tracking, and multi-store inventory synchronization.
  - [Cloud Group Retail & Treasury](https://cloudgroup-et.com/): Multi-tier wholesale and retail POS with treasury reconciliation.
  - [Yusra Baltina](https://yusrabaltina.com/): Bulk spice and traditional grains POS with batch expiry tracking.
  - [Yoban Kitchenware](https://yoban-et.com/): High-SKU kitchenware inventory management with barcode printing.
  - [Nur Selam Baltina Shop](https://shop.nurselambaltina.com/): Retail consumer storefront with real-time factory stock synchronization.
  - [Ethio Yarn Store](https://ethioyarnstores.com/): Omnichannel retail suite with Flutter mobile shopping app and GPS delivery calculations.
- [Non-Profit & Humanitarian Ecosystem](https://hamzajhad.com/work): Comprehensive social welfare tech suite.
  - [Eznet Child Care Portal](https://eznet-cp.com/): Sponsorship and child welfare tracking portal.
  - [Metezazen Charity](https://metezazen.org/): QR-verified meal voucher distribution across partner dining venues.
  - [My Charities Foundation](https://mycharities-foundation.org/): International philanthropic campaigns and verifiable metrics.
  - [Dar Al-Fiker Foundation](https://daralfiker.org/): Orphan sponsorship and relief operations.
  - [Afak Organization](https://www.afakorganization.com/): Disaster relief and youth capacity building portal.
  - [Mamedoch Association](https://mamedoch.org/): Community welfare initiative and mutual aid fund.
  - [Ethiopian Ahle Sunna Mosque Network](https://ethioahlesunnah.org/): Nationwide institution network, prayer schedules, and regional applications.
  - [Arefa Islamic Institution](https://arefaic.org/): Multilingual community portal with localized CMS and donations.
  - [Atika Women's Center](https://atikawec.com/): Educational administrative suite with digital student ID generation.
- [Sara Mall Property & Tenant ERP](https://hamzajhad.com/work): Commercial retail building ERP managing leasing units, tenant lifecycle, and automated billing.
